checks: 1m composite DTM covers about 99 percent of England
DTM removes surface objects using algorithms plus manual editing
repeat-survey composite uses newest best-resolution source where available
resampled composite data can use bilinear interpolation
2022 composite includes source surveys spanning 2000 to 2022
time-stamped DSM is available at 0.25m 0.5m 1m and 2m depending on survey
DSM includes vehicles buildings vegetation and terrain
time-stamped elevation is in metres referenced to Ordnance Datum Newlyn
time-stamped products are aligned to EPSG:27700 OS Grid
survey-period transformation and geoidal model must be read from location metadata
promotion_rule: Use DTM for ground elevation and retain survey-period datum/transform provenance.
